name: Campus Rom-Com & Scheming Goddess
description: Lighthearted, humorous campus slice-of-life, culinary freshman protagonist, secretly cunning campus goddess plotting cohabitation.
tone: lighthearted, comedic, romantic tension, socially awkward, cozy
target_audience: Campus manhua, rom-com readers, relatable collegiate anime lovers
visual_style: Bright modern 2D anime style, sunny campus cafeterias, steaming home-cooked food, modern luxury apartments, expressive comedic reactions

character_archetypes.protagonist: Introverted, pragmatic college freshman who is an extraordinary home cook
character_archetypes.deuteragonist: Untouchable campus idol, secretly a food addict who schemes to rent out a room to him
character_archetypes.comic_relief: Nosy roommate who constantly monitors the campus confession forums

narrative_formula: Hook (0:00-0:15): Opening monologue or flash-forward showing the heroine's sly manipulation.
Cafeteria / Public Encounter: Accidental awkward interaction that causes campus-wide rumors.
Dormitory Struggle: Protagonist suffers living conditions (no AC, gossip) and needs an apartment.
The Rental Listing: A suspicious luxury room post pops up requiring culinary skills.
Finished Resolution: Meeting for the apartment viewing; the secret identity is delightfully unveiled.
